name: Crate of Lightforge Ingots
summary: In Stormwind, the Crate of Lightforge Ingots carries Duskwood's hope against Morbent Fel.

sections.title: A Sacred Delivery
sections.body: Lightforge iron is rare, and its consecrated metal channels holy power against dark entities. Morbent Fel's protections turn aside ordinary steel, so Duskwood looks to these ingots against the necromancer. Only an artisan who knows the metal's temper and honors its sacred nature can work it.

sections.title: The Weaponsmith of Stormwind
sections.body: The crate is bound for Grimand Elmore, a skilled dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District. He has not worked with lightforge iron in years, yet agrees to forge it into a sanctified weapon. The weapon is meant to break Morbent Fel's defenses and strike him down.

faq.answer: The crate holds consecrated lightforge iron for a weapon meant to pierce Morbent Fel's magical defenses.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive this crate?

angles.text: Working lightforge iron is a rare art. Even Grimand Elmore can go years without handling the sacred metal.
These ingots answer the Holy Light. Weapons forged from them are a natural bane to necromancers and their undead minions.
